items.title: Bernard Purdie interviewed by Monk Rowe, West Orange, New Jersey, July 30, 2003
items.q: I re-recorded it and brought it with a different sound... That particular record... Doris Troy?

ctx.x: “Love is Strange.” Yeah. See their first record, the first one that they did in the early fifties was mostly all swing. But it was re-recorded in ’60, ’61. I re-recorded it and brought it with a different sound. Almost straight. But if you hear the record that’s been played all these years, for the last forty years, it’s been their record of the straight time. Not the one that was the shuffle, but more of the straight time. Strings and all. The sound that they had with her moaning and doing two or three different…
